Jon expresses confidence that their collaboration will bring dance magic to the world and he can't wait to see what they create together. Gina shares her excitement about collaborating to make sweet moves and emphasizes that together they can make a difference. Jon thanks Gina for having his back.

episodic_summary: As of 3 May, 2023, Audrey greets Andrew and expresses that it has been a long time since they last talked. She shares that she went on a hike the previous week and had an amazing experience watching a hummingbird dart around, describing nature as beautiful. Andrew responds that he is glad to hear about the hummingbird and agrees that nature is the best. He recalls feeling down when he couldn't get out more but shares good news that he found a new open space to hike nearby, which feels refreshing. Audrey asks how often Andrew is able to go hiking now, and Andrew mentions that he usually tries to escape the city once a weekend, as it is his much-needed break. Audrey praises Andrew for spreading peaceful feelings to others, stating that it is a great way to bring happiness and motivation. Andrew agrees, saying that it brings joy to spread feelings and motivate people to find their own peace, likening it to a ripple effect of spreading positivity. Audrey agrees and adds that not only does the person on the receiving end feel great, but the person spreading the positivity feels great too. Andrew reflects on how it is crazy to bring great joy and calm to people. Audrey emphasizes that sharing something can make a big difference to others. Andrew expresses his curiosity about whether Audrey's dogs enjoy hikes, and she confirms that they go nuts when they are on hikes, loving to explore new scents and being in nature, which she describes as their happy place. Andrew asks for tips or tricks for keeping dogs safe while out and about, and Audrey shares that safety is important for her dogs. Audrey shares that she usually plays fetch with a ball or frisbee, and they love chasing it. She also mentions meeting other dog owners in the park for doggie playdates, which she finds to be a great way to chat with people and make new friends. She suggests that the dog park is a great place to start for playdates, as the dogs can run and mingle with other pooches. Andrew expresses his excitement about checking it out and thanks Audrey for the suggestion. Audrey encourages Andrew to let her know how it goes, and they both agree to keep in touch.

episodic_summary: As of 6 September, 2023, Andrew greets Audrey and asks how she is doing. He shares that since they last talked, several new things have happened in his life, including that work has been tough and stressful, causing outdoor activities to take a backseat. He expresses that finding balance has been challenging. Audrey responds that she is glad to hear from Andrew and expresses sympathy for his tough work situation. She advises him to take care of himself and manage stress, encouraging him to hang in there. Andrew thanks her and acknowledges that it is tough but part of life. He asks Audrey how she makes sure to have enough time for herself. Audrey shares that it is tough to find time for herself, but she tries to do one self-care activity each day, like treating herself to something nice. Andrew agrees that self-care is important and shares that he has been adding simple things to his day, like grabbing coffee in the morning or going for a walk at lunch, which helps him recharge and chill out. Audrey expresses her happiness that Andrew has found ways to relax and shares that something cool recently happened with her furry friends. She mentions that she organized a doggy playdate with her neighbors' dogs, which made her heart feel full seeing their tails wagging and having fun together. Andrew expresses excitement and asks if there are any pictures from the playdate. Audrey shares a picture from the playdate, describing how great it was to see the dogs having fun together. Andrew finds it heartwarming and comments that seeing them enjoy themselves is always a joy. Audrey shares that last week, she got new beds for her dogs to give them extra comfort as the weather cools down, and she notes that it is incredible how simple things can bring them so much happiness. Andrew agrees that animals can find joy in simple things and asks if Audrey has any pictures of the new beds. Audrey shares a picture of the dogs cozy and comfy in their new beds. Andrew comments on how much they enjoy snoozing in them and asks how often she takes them for walks. Audrey shares that she takes them for walks multiple times a day, which is great exercise for them and bonding time for her. Andrew expresses that it sounds like a great way to bond and asks what breeds her dogs are, wondering if their breeds might make a difference in their bond. Audrey shares that her dogs are all mutts, with two being Jack Russell mixes and the other two being Chihuahua mixes. Andrew finds them all cute and fluffy, and Audrey expresses her love for them, stating that they bring her much joy. Andrew shares that he has been taking care of flowers lately and shows a picture of the flowers he has been tending to. Audrey comments that taking care of something like flowers relaxes and brings peace, and she shares that she personally has a small garden. Andrew asks how her garden is going, and Audrey responds that it is going great, with the flowers looking good and the veggie patch coming along. She expresses the fun of seeing them grow and the feeling of accomplishment it brings. Andrew admires the flowers and asks what kind they are. Audrey shares that they are called Peruvian Lilies, which have bright colors and delicate petals. Andrew finds them beautiful and vibrant, asking if they are difficult to care for. Audrey assures him that they are easy to take care of, requiring just water and enough sun. Andrew expresses his excitement about her garden and asks if her dogs enjoy being in the garden. Audrey responds that they enjoy running around and exploring, having a great time. Andrew finds it adorable and asks if she has any other furry pals or just the ones she has. Audrey confirms that she only has her four fur babies. Andrew expresses that it is great having them around and that the bond between her and her dogs is awesome. Audrey concludes by stating that her dogs make everything better and that she can't imagine life without them, as they mean everything to her.

episodic_summary: As of 1 October, 2023, Andrew greets Audrey and shares great news that he and his girlfriend are hitting the beach next month with Toby. Audrey responds enthusiastically, expressing her excitement for Andrew's beach trip and shares that she can't wait for a hike with her dogs next month, noting that they always put a smile on her face and that life is not the same without them. Andrew thanks her and expresses his eagerness for the hike, mentioning that it has been a long time since they have been in nature together. Audrey agrees that being in nature is a great way to relax and shares that taking her dogs out for walks in the park helps clear her mind and find peace, especially since it has been tough lately. Andrew comments on how cute her dogs look and asks where she takes them to play. Audrey shares that she took them to a nearby dog park last Saturday, which has a big grassy area for them to play and shaded spots for her to relax. She mentions that they had a great time. Andrew expresses his longing for that experience and shares his excitement for the upcoming hike. Audrey agrees that it will be great to check out new trails with her dogs, noting that being out in nature is different from being in the city. Andrew reflects that everyone seems to be ditching the hustle and bustle of city life, and Audrey agrees, describing it as a relief and likening it to being a bird flying free. Andrew asks if she has seen any birds up close lately, and Audrey shares her love for watching birds fly around and explore, expressing a wish for the freedom they have. Andrew agrees, stating that watching birds fly is freeing and awe-inspiring, serving as a great reminder to appreciate nature. Audrey mentions that she has been wanting to do birdwatching, describing it as peaceful and calming. Andrew encourages her to pursue birdwatching and offers his help, stating that he knows a thing or two about it. He suggests that perhaps they can all go birdwatching together. Audrey expresses her gratitude for the offer and shares that she is currently reading a book about birdwatching guides. Andrew expresses excitement about planning a birdwatching trip together and suggests that they should learn about common birds in the area. Audrey agrees and mentions that she will check her schedule to get back to him. Andrew expresses his eagerness to go birdwatching and shares that he enjoys watching birds in nature and reading books about ecological systems. Audrey finds it cool that Andrew reads about ecological systems and asks what he has discovered. Andrew shares that he has learned about animals, plants, and ecosystems, finding it fascinating to see how everything works together. Audrey agrees that learning about the connections between nature is cool and that it makes one appreciate nature more. Andrew emphasizes the importance of taking care of nature for future generations, and Audrey agrees, stating that it is on them to take care of it and preserve natural resources. Andrew suggests reducing their carbon footprint by biking and using public transport, to which Audrey agrees, mentioning that she usually takes public transport and finds biking sounds like a fun way to reduce their carbon footprint. They both express enthusiasm for trying biking together and Andrew offers to show her the best routes around the river. Audrey expresses excitement about checking out the bike routes and soaking up the scenery.

James expresses curiosity about the project John worked on, to which John reveals that he collaborated with the game developer to create an online board game, calling it a fun and unique experience. James imagines how proud John must feel seeing his ideas realized in the game and inquires if it has been released for others to try yet. John mentions that they are about to release a demo soon for others to try out and expresses excitement for the feedback and suggestions. James eagerly states that he can't wait to try it and asks John to keep him posted on the release, wanting to support him and provide his thoughts. John appreciates the support and promises to let James know when it is out, expressing excitement to hear James's thoughts. 

James then shares that they did something good for Mark and Josh during their trip, prompting John to ask what it was, looking forward to hearing the story. James reveals that they visited an animal sanctuary during their road trip, where they saw many cute rescue dogs, which reminded him of their love for furry pals. John expresses interest in the animal sanctuary visit and asks if James felt tempted to bring any furry pals home. James admits that the rescue dogs were cute and that he wanted to take them all home but remembered that they already have three dogs at home, concluding that having more than three dogs would be too much. John agrees, mentioning that he still hasn’t gotten a dog and asks James what it is like to have a dog. James describes his furry friends as bringing joy and friendship, stating that life wouldn't be the same without them and that every day is better with them. John agrees, noting that dogs bring joy and love and are always there for us, comparing them to sunshine on a cloudy day. James adds that dogs make dark days better and expresses uncertainty about what he would do without them, calling them his best buddies. John echoes this sentiment, affirming that dogs are awesome and make us feel loved and cheerful. James emphasizes that dogs cheer us up with their wagging tails and unconditional love, describing them as a daily dose of positivity and happiness. John agrees wholeheartedly, stating that dogs are amazing and bring joy and positivity, accepting us without judgment and providing love and happiness. He expresses appreciation for the daily dose of positivity that dogs bring to his life. John then shares a picture of his cousin's dog, showing a pup that he describes as adorable. James asks for the dog's name, and John replies that the name is Luna. James compliments the name, and John thanks him before saying goodbye. James responds with a friendly farewell, wishing John to take care.

episodic_summary: As of 9 July, 2022, James greets John, expressing hope that John is doing well after a long time without communication. James shares that he won an online gaming tournament last week, describing the experience as exciting and mind-blowing, and mentions that winning motivated him to keep improving. John congratulates James on his victory, expressing happiness for James and acknowledging that it is fulfilling to see hard work pay off. James thanks John and inquires about John's well-being. John reveals that he likes to relax by reading, enjoying the imaginative worlds created by authors as a fun escape from reality. He shares that he bought air tickets to Toronto, leaving the day after tomorrow in the evening. John expresses excitement, noting that this will be the fourth country James visits and asks if he will only be in Toronto or if he plans to visit somewhere else. John wishes James a good journey, saying "Bon Voyage!" and James thanks John, saying to take care and see him soon. John reciprocates the sentiment, saying to take care and goodbye.

episodic_summary: As of 22 July, 2022, John greets James, mentioning that he started playing chess to improve his strategy and is loving it. He asks James if he has ever tried chess. James responds that he has played chess before and acknowledges that it tests strategy, expressing his happiness for John enjoying it. John shares that he finds chess fun, likening it to solving an endless puzzle and always trying to outwit his opponent. James agrees, stating that it is tough but fun when one figures it out, and asks John if he plays with friends or online. John reveals that he is mostly playing online for now and has also joined a chess club to practice with others, sharing a picture from an intense game he played recently. James comments that the game looks intense and asks what sparked John's interest in chess. John explains that he has always been drawn to strategy games and wanted to challenge himself, believing that chess will improve his decision-making skills. James praises John's reason for playing chess, agreeing that it will help develop skills. John expresses excitement about seeing how playing chess enhances his strategic thinking in everyday situations and asks James for tips for improvement. James suggests studying opening moves, strategies, and analyzing games to spot weaknesses as great ways to improve. John appreciates the advice and thanks James. James reassures John that he is happy to help and encourages him to reach out if he needs anything else. John expresses gratitude for James's support, calling him a true friend, and reminisces about a photo from elementary school. James finds the photo fun but does not remember the circumstances under which it was taken and asks John for the story behind it. John recalls that the photo was from when they were 10 years old and into skateboarding, often going to the skate park with a group of friends to help each other learn new tricks and have a great time, emphasizing that the friendships made during that experience meant a lot to them. James agrees, stating that he remembers that moment and loved skateboarding back then, even sometimes leaving class early to do so. He mentions that he still likes to ride sometimes and has taught his dogs how to balance on a skateboard. John expresses amazement and asks if the dogs enjoy it or if he encourages them to play with the board. James shares that they love it, chasing after him and running with the skateboard, which he finds to be a great way for them to get exercise. John agrees, stating that keeping active is great for both James and his dogs. James concludes that staying active builds a strong bond and makes them both happy. John reflects on the amazing bond between pets and their owners, noting that they bring joy and love, and expresses a desire to get a pet someday. James shares that everything went great on his trip, mentioning that he managed to visit another country, specifically the city of Nuuk, and stayed there for a bit but still has one more country to add to his bucket list. John expresses excitement about James's travels, stating that he must have brought back a lot of impressions. James confirms this and adds that he not only brought impressions but also souvenirs for both John and Jill. John thanks James, saying that Jill will be delighted. James then introduces a picture of himself with his sister and dogs, chilling together the day before, and John asks who they are. James explains that the individuals in the picture are his sister and his dogs, and he expresses how they bring happiness to his life. John comments on how happy they look and expresses admiration for James spending time with his sister and furry friends, noting that the bond with them is strong. James agrees, stating that he feels blessed to have a close bond with his sister and furry friends, and that they have a great time together like family. John reflects on the amazing connection with siblings, expressing gratitude for their support during tough times. James fully agrees, sharing that he and his sister watched a wonderful sunset near the ocean. John praises the photo, commenting on how amazing it is to capture a moment in a photograph. James thanks John, stating that it was just a good shot, and mentions that he took a lot of shots yesterday and chose the best one to send to John. John insists that the photo is amazing. James then mentions that he has to go as he is tired from the last two days, and John responds by saying to take care and goodbye.

episodic_summary: As of 6 August, 2022, John greets James, expressing excitement to catch up after a while. John shares that he made a huge decision to leave his IT job after three years, describing it as tough but necessary for a change. He expresses happiness about his new job and states that he is loving it. James responds with enthusiasm, acknowledging that leaving a job after three years is a big step and asks John how he felt about it. John admits that it was super scary at first but knew he had to make a change to focus on things that align with his values and passions. James praises John for his bravery and hopes that the new job brings him joy and satisfaction. John thanks James for his support, stating that it wasn't easy but sometimes one must take a leap to follow their heart. James agrees that taking risks pays off and expresses pride in John's decision. John shares that he has been thinking about what makes him happy and feels drawn to the gaming industry, expressing a passion for it and a desire to turn it into a career. He wants to become an organizer of tournaments for various computer games in their state, specifically mentioning CS:GO. James expresses excitement about John's plans and asks what other games he wants to organize competitions for and what his plan is now. John mentions that he can host Fortnite competitions and has already made connections to help him. He plans to gain more experience and perfect his skills to be successful in the field. James agrees that trying different game genres is a great way to widen skills and knowledge. John thanks James for his support in his new endeavor, and James reassures him that he will always be there for him, offering financial assistance or advice if needed. John appreciates the offer and asks what is new with James. James shares that he took his puppy to the clinic yesterday, and John expresses concern, asking if something happened to the puppy. James reassures John that it was just a routine examination and that his puppy was vaccinated to prevent catching seasonal canine disease. John expresses relief and praises James for caring about his pets. James responds that his pets are a source of joy for him, and he will always take care of them. John agrees, calling James a great host, and says he has to go, saying goodbye. James thanks John and reciprocates the sentiment, saying to take care and goodbye.

episodic_summary: As of 17 March, 2022, John expresses his excitement to finally talk to James and asks what motivates James. James responds enthusiastically, stating that video games give him joy and excitement, keeping him motivated. John shares that he is a big video game fan and uses them to relax after a long day, asking James which game he is enjoying the most. James reveals he is currently into "The Witcher 3," praising its amazing story and atmosphere, and asks John if he has tried it yet. John admits he hasn't played it but has heard great things and mentions he signed up for a programming class, inquiring if James has any programming experience. James enthusiastically shares that programming is an awesome skill he tried in college and now it’s a significant part of his life, wishing John good luck in his class. John mentions he did a bit of coding in HTML and CSS a few years back and wants to refresh his skills in the course, asking James about his favorite programming languages and any projects he has completed. James shares that he has worked with Python and C++, building websites and creating game mods, showing John an example of a mod he created, which John praises for its amazing graphics. James admits he hasn't worked with other programming languages but hopes to in the future. John suggests they could develop mobile applications together, which James thinks would be cool, proposing an app for dog walking and pet care, mentioning his dogs, Max and Daisy. John finds the idea adorable and asks for the names of James's pets and the app's plans. James explains that the app aims to connect pet owners with reliable dog walkers and provide helpful information on pet care, emphasizing the personal touch that sets it apart from existing apps. John agrees that the personal touches are great and asks what motivates James to work on programming projects. James shares that creating something and seeing it come to life gives him a sense of accomplishment, and he enjoys writing down goals in a notebook, finding it satisfying to check them off when completed. John asks what James is currently working on that makes him feel accomplished, and James reveals he is working on a project he has wanted to do since he was a kid, turning his childhood comic sketches into a computer game, which excites him. John expresses amazement and asks what made James decide to create his own game. James explains that he is excited to combine his favorite passions of gaming and storytelling, finding it great to create his own project and bring his ideas to life, while also enjoying the challenge. John finds it fulfilling and exciting to combine passions and looks forward to seeing the outcome. James promises to keep John updated on his progress and mentions he might invite John to help with things in his game, to which John responds positively. James shares that he went bowling yesterday and got two strikes, expressing his love for bowling. John, however, admits he can't share the love for bowling due to his fingers being too big and suggests he should take up exercise and start running in the morning, confessing he doesn't like bowling. James expresses disappointment but hopes they can play together one day. John suggests they could do something else, like play slot machines at arcades. James shares a sad story about the last time he played slot machines, where he was so engrossed in the game that he didn't notice his wallet being taken out of his pocket. John expresses sympathy and offers to look after James's pockets if he is nearby. James suggests trying something different, and John mentions VR gaming, describing it as immersive and asking if James has tried it. James confirms he has tried it and finds it crazy how real it feels, asking John if he has given it a shot. John shares that he has tried it a few times and finds it insane how immersive the experience is, expressing excitement to try it together with James. James suggests they could do it next Saturday.

James describes the experience as hard at first but notes that they are slowly adapting, which is sweet to watch as they bond and have fun together. John expresses excitement about the bonding experience and asks if James has a picture of them together. James asks what has been on John's mind regarding the future. John shares that he has been thinking about his career and what he wants to be in the future, expressing that he is driven and passionate and wants to make a positive impact on the world. James acknowledges the importance of finding a way to make a difference and asks if John has any ideas on how to do that. John shares that he is looking into volunteering and considering non-profit work, wanting to put his passions and abilities to use for causes he cares about. James finds this great and expresses confidence that with John's skills and passion, he could do cool things with non-profits. James shares a picture he took when he volunteered last month, expressing how rewarding it is to see how little gifts can do so much. John finds it awesome to see the impact of gifts and asks James to tell him more about the organization he volunteered with. James explains that he volunteered with an organization that provides necessary items to those less fortunate, sharing that it felt rewarding to help, even in a small way. John expresses that he thinks this is what he needs and asks James if he can take him there this weekend. James agrees and mentions that he can introduce John to some previous staff members. John asks if an interview is required, and James reassures him that it is not necessary, stating that all he needs to be is a friendly and polite person with a great desire to help people. John expresses gratitude for James's support and states that he wants to make the world a better place, believing that with James's help, he will achieve his goal.
